description_en: Revokes the authorization granted by a VPC-connected instance to a VBR instance in a cross-account VBR connection scenario
description_zh: 调用RevokeInstanceFromVbr接口取消跨账号创建VBR上连场景下VPC实例对VBR实例的授权
kebab_example: aliyun vpc revoke-instance-from-vbr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-owner-uid 1210123456123456 --instance-id vpc-bp1brjuegjc88v3u90000 --grant-type ALL --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeInstanceFromVbr

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPC-connected instance for which you want to revoke the authorization. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要取消授权的VPC实例所在地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBR instance from which the authorization is revoked
parameters.help_zh: 取消接受授权的VBR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: vbr_owner_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of VBR instance IDs from which the authorization of the VPC-connected instance is revoked
parameters.help_zh: 取消接受VPC实例授权的VBR实例ID列表
parameters.name: vbr_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The VPC-connected instance ID for which you want to revoke the authorization
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of VBR instances from which the authorization of the VPC-connected instance is revoked. Valid values:

ALL: revokes the authorization between the VPC-connected instance and all VBR instances in the specified region. In this case, the VbrInstanceIds parameter can be left empty.

Specify: revokes the authorization between the VPC-connected instance and the specified VBR instances. In this case, the VbrInstanceIds parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
取消接受VPC实例授权的VBR实例范围。取值：

ALL：表示取消指定地域内的所有VBR实例的VPC实例授权关系，此时VbrInstanceIds参数可以为空。

Specify：表示取消指定VBR实例的VPC实例授权关系，此时VbrInstanceIds参数需要配置
parameters.name: grant_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VBR instance from which the authorization of the VPC-connected instance is revoked
parameters.help_zh: 要取消接受VPC实例授权的VBR实例所在地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_region_no
